contract.topology: Root retains one construction-status endpoint receive cap; only the dedicated probe receives one fixed endpoint send cap.
contract.transaction: Root validates exactly (REQUEST, slot=1, generation=1), replies (READY, slot=1, generation=1) with zero extra caps, then returns to main's idle flow.
contract.authority: The dispatch handler contains no allocator, VSpace, process-loader, TCB, untyped, device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O, IOSpace or Linux clone operation.

required_markers: SeLinOS root dispatch M0: isolated request endpoint ready.
SeLinOS root dispatch M0: exact fixed request accepted.
SeLinOS root dispatch M0: fixed status reply issued; no child constructed.
SeLinOS M0: root task entering idle/yield loop.
SeLinOS root dispatch M0 probe: fixed root status transaction passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS M0: root dispatch M0 transaction FAILED.
SeLinOS root dispatch M0 probe: fixed reply rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M1: child constructed.

not_claimed: root child construction, dynamic allocation, process-loader invocation, capability delivery or child start
objectd or memd allocator authority, taskd ownership or a reusable root construction service
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading, dpkg or apt
